name: Groq
description: Let your AI use GroqCloud with your own API key: fast chat completions from open models such as Llama, GPT-OSS and Qwen, speech-to-text and translation of audio files from a link with Whisper, and the model list, batch jobs and files of the account.
prerequisites: A GroqCloud account and an API key from console.groq.com/keys. The free plan works within its rate limits; on the Developer plan every model call is billed to the organization. About 2 minutes.

GROQ_API_KEY.label: Groq API key
GROQ_API_KEY.help: console.groq.com, API Keys, Create API Key. Groq shows the key once. Calls are counted against the organization's limits and, on the Developer plan, billed to it.
GROQ_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the key as Groq shows it, starting with gsk_, without spaces and without the word Bearer.

verifyHints.401: Groq refused the API key: it is wrong or was deleted. Create a new one at https://console.groq.com/keys.
verifyHints.403: The key's organization or project may not use this model or endpoint. Check the project's model permissions in the GroqCloud console.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Groq rate limited the key. Free plan limits are per minute and per day; wait and try again, or upgrade at https://console.groq.com/settings/billing.

instructions:
## Groq
This connector calls the **GroqCloud API** (`https://api.groq.com/openai/v1`, OpenAI-compatible) with the user's own key: very fast chat completions from open models hosted by Groq (Llama, OpenAI GPT-OSS, Qwen and others), speech-to-text and speech translation with Whisper, and the model list, batch jobs and files of the organization.

**Paid calls**: `groq_chat_completion`, `groq_transcribe_audio` and `groq_translate_audio` run a model. On the free plan they are free but rate limited; on the Developer plan each call is billed (per token for text, per hour of audio for Whisper, with a 10 second minimum per request). Confirm with the user before large or repeated calls, and set `max_completion_tokens` to cap a reply. The model, batch and file reads cost nothing.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://console.groq.com.
2. Open **API Keys** (https://console.groq.com/keys), click **Create API Key**, name it and copy it (it starts with `gsk_` and is shown only once).
3. Paste it into `GROQ_API_KEY`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer` and only to Groq.
4. Run `groq_list_models` to check the key.

**Workflow**
- Choose a model: `groq_list_models` lists every model the key can use with its `context_window` and `max_completion_tokens`; `groq_get_model` reads one. Model ids change often; preview models can be removed at short notice, production models are stable. Common ids: `llama-3.3-70b-versatile`, `llama-3.1-8b-instant` (cheapest), `openai/gpt-oss-120b`, `openai/gpt-oss-20b`, `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`; Whisper: `whisper-large-v3-turbo` (cheaper) and `whisper-large-v3`.
- Generate text: `groq_chat_completion` with `model` and `messages`. `response_format` asks for JSON or a JSON schema, `tools` adds function calling, `reasoning_effort` and `reasoning_format` steer reasoning models (GPT-OSS takes `low`, `medium`, `high`; Qwen takes `none` or `default`). The result carries `_headers` with the remaining requests and tokens of the rate limit.
- Audio: `groq_transcribe_audio` turns speech into text in its own language, `groq_translate_audio` into English text (only `whisper-large-v3` translates). Both take a **public link** to the audio file (`url`): Groq downloads it itself, so no upload is needed. Formats flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm. Pass `language` (ISO-639-1, e.g. `de`) when known: it is faster and more accurate. `response_format` `verbose_json` adds segments with timestamps, and `timestamp_granularities` `word` word timings.
- Batch jobs started elsewhere: `groq_list_batches` and `groq_get_batch` show status, request counts and the `output_file_id` / `error_file_id`; `groq_list_files` and `groq_get_file` show the files (purpose `batch` or `batch_output`). Content download, upload, creating and cancelling batches are not part of this connector.

**Reading answers**: a completion returns `choices[0].message.content`, `finish_reason` (`stop`, `length` when `max_completion_tokens` was hit, `tool_calls`), and `usage` with token counts and timings in seconds. Reasoning models may put their reasoning in `choices[0].message.reasoning`. Transcriptions return `text`. `created`, `created_at` and other timestamps are Unix seconds, UTC. File sizes are bytes.

**Limits**: rate limits are per organization and model (requests and tokens per minute and per day); see https://console.groq.com/settings/limits. Audio links can point to files up to 100 MB on paid plans and 25 MB on the free plan.

**Errors**: 400 bad parameter (e.g. a parameter the model does not support, or audio that cannot be read); 401 invalid key; 403 the project may not use the model; 404 unknown model, batch or file; 413 audio too large; 429 rate limit reached (wait the seconds in `retry-after`, do not loop); 498 flex tier capacity exceeded; 500 and 503 Groq-side errors, retry once later.

tools.name: groq_list_models
tools.description: List the models this Groq API key can use (chat, reasoning, Whisper speech-to-text, text-to-speech, safety), with owner, context window, maximum completion tokens and whether each is active. Free.

tools.name: groq_get_model
tools.description: Read one Groq model: owner, creation time, context window, maximum completion tokens and whether it is active. Answers 404 for a model id the key cannot use. Free.

model.description: Model id as listed by groq_list_models, e.g. llama-3.3-70b-versatile or openai/gpt-oss-120b.

tools.name: groq_chat_completion
tools.description: Send a conversation to a Groq-hosted model and return its reply (non-streaming). COSTS MONEY on the Developer plan: billed per input and output token to the Groq organization (free plan: free within rate limits). Confirm with the user before larger or repeated calls and set max_completion_tokens to cap the cost. The result includes _headers with the remaining rate limit.

model.description: Model id from groq_list_models, e.g. llama-3.3-70b-versatile, llama-3.1-8b-instant (cheapest), openai/gpt-oss-120b.

messages.description: The conversation, oldest first: [{"role": "system", "content": "..."}, {"role": "user", "content": "..."}]. Roles: system, user, assistant, tool. For vision models content can be a list of parts such as {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://..."}}.

max_completion_tokens.description: Upper bound on generated tokens, reasoning included. Set it to cap cost.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature 0-2; lower is more deterministic.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where generation stops.

response_format.description: Structured output: {"type": "json_object"}, or {"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {"name": "result", "strict": true, "schema": {...}}} on models that support it.

tools.description: Function definitions the model may call: [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}}]. The model answers with tool_calls; run them and send the results back as role tool messages.

tool_choice.description: none, auto, required, or {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "..."}} to force one function.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort of reasoning models: low, medium or high for openai/gpt-oss-*; none or default for Qwen models. Other values are refused with 400.

reasoning_format.description: How reasoning is returned: parsed (in message.reasoning), raw (inside the content) or hidden.

service_tier.description: Service tier, default on_demand. flex answers or fails fast (error 498) when capacity is short.

tools.name: groq_transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe speech in an audio file to text in its own language with Whisper. Pass a public link to the file; Groq downloads it itself (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm). COSTS MONEY on the Developer plan: billed per hour of audio, at least 10 seconds per request. Confirm with the user before transcribing long recordings.

url.description: Public HTTPS link to the audio file.

model.description: whisper-large-v3-turbo (default, cheaper and faster) or whisper-large-v3 (most accurate).

language.description: Language of the audio as an ISO-639-1 code, e.g. en, de, it. Improves accuracy and speed.

prompt.description: Optional text to guide spelling and style, in the language of the audio (names, terms, the previous segment).

response_format.description: json (default, {text}), text (plain text) or verbose_json (segments with timestamps).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature 0-1; 0 lets the model adapt it.

timestamp_granularities.description: With response_format verbose_json: word or segment timestamps (segments are included by default).

tools.name: groq_translate_audio
tools.description: Translate speech in an audio file into English text with Whisper (only whisper-large-v3 translates). Pass a public link to the file; Groq downloads it itself. COSTS MONEY on the Developer plan: billed per hour of audio, at least 10 seconds per request. Confirm with the user before translating long recordings.

url.description: Public HTTPS link to the audio file (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm).

prompt.description: Optional English text to guide spelling and style.

tools.name: groq_list_batches
tools.description: List the Batch API jobs of the Groq organization: endpoint, status (validating, in_progress, finalizing, completed, failed, expired, cancelling, cancelled), request counts, completion window, input, output and error file ids and timestamps. Free.

tools.name: groq_get_batch
tools.description: Read one Groq batch job: status, timestamps of each stage, request counts (total, completed, failed), errors, metadata and the output_file_id and error_file_id. Free.

tools.name: groq_list_files
tools.description: List the files stored in the Groq organization (batch inputs and batch outputs) with id, file name, size in bytes, purpose and creation time. Does not download content. Free.

tools.name: groq_get_file
tools.description: Read the metadata of one Groq file: name, size in bytes, purpose (batch or batch_output) and creation time. Does not download the content. Free.

file_id.description: File id (file_...) from groq_list_files or a batch's output_file_id / error_file_id.
